summary: GCL Global Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification dated September 16, 2026, transferring its ordinary shares to The Nasdaq Capital Market at the open on September 18, 2026, and granting an additional 180-day cure period to March 15, 2027 for the $1.00 minimum bid price deficiency. The company had failed the initial period ending September 14, 2026, and told Nasdaq it may effect a reverse stock split if necessary. Compliance requires a $1.00 bid for at least 10 consecutive business days; failure risks delisting, with appeal rights.
